$comment: Predictable Revenue (Ross & Tyler, 2011) — probes. Fase E2E: sales (prospecting) + repeatable demand. Target utama: DM5.1 (demand insufficiency), DS4.2 (distribution inactivity), C6.4 (response/follow-up failure).

probes.text: How many NEW prospective customers have you contacted this week (active outreach — email/call/DM/pitch)?

signal_interpretation.positive: Ada angka outreach konsisten per minggu — pipeline discipline mulai terbentuk, DS4.2 turun
signal_interpretation.negative: Nol / hampir nol outreach proaktif minggu ini — demand tergantung momentum/ inbound semata, DS4.2 naik
signal_interpretation.neutral: There's outreach, but it's not consistent every week — need to measure consistency (streak)

probes.text: If a prospective customer says "later" or asks for a follow-up — when did you last follow up, and how many days have passed since the last contact?

signal_interpretation.positive: Follow-up terjadwal dan dijalankan < 7 hari — C6.4 rendah
signal_interpretation.negative: Banyak balasan/inquiry dibiarkan tanpa follow-up, atau follow-up > 2 minggu — inquiry bocor, C6.4 naik kuat
signal_interpretation.neutral: Follow-up exists but without a schedule/system — prone to leaking as volume increases.

probes.text: Out of the 10 prospects you contacted, roughly how many actually match your ideal customer profile — and how many did you contact just because they 'happened to be there'?

signal_interpretation.positive: List dibangun dari kriteria ICP — conversion pipeline lebih mungkin, M3.1 turun
signal_interpretation.negative: Spray-and-pray ke siapa pun — response rate rendah bawaan, M3.1 dan DM5.1 naik
signal_interpretation.neutral: Ada filter longgar — perlu probe definisi ICP eksplisit

probes.text: Right now, who handles prospecting → replying to inquiries → closing—is it all you by yourself, or is there a division of labor?

signal_interpretation.positive: There is role specialization (though simple) — the process can stay consistent under load
signal_interpretation.negative: Semua role satu orang tanpa blok waktu khusus prospek — prospek selalu kalah oleh pekerjaan 'mendesak', DS4.2 & L8.1 naik
signal_interpretation.neutral: Pembagian informal — efektif selama volume rendah

probes.text: What metrics do you use to tell whether your customer search engine is healthy or not (e.g., number of meetings/replies per week, inquiry→closing conversion)?

signal_interpretation.positive: There is a weekly leading indicator being monitored — demand can be predicted & improved
signal_interpretation.negative: Tidak ada ukuran pipeline sama sekali — 'sepi' selalu misteri, diagnosis DM5.1 tak terdiferensiasi
signal_interpretation.neutral: Hanya ukur hasil akhir (omzet) tanpa ukuran proses — terlambat deteksi

probes.text: Why do prospective customers who are already interested end up not going through — what are the most common reasons they give (or that you suspect)?

signal_interpretation.positive: There is a recorded pattern of reasoning — leakage can be localized to a specific stage.
signal_interpretation.negative: Tidak tahu sama sekali kenapa bocor — inquiry hilang diam-diam, C6.4 tak terdiagnosis
signal_interpretation.neutral: Knows case by case but without a pattern — need to log loss-reason

probes.text: Siapa yang biasanya menandatangani keputusan pembelian untuk layanan seperti ini, dan berapa lama prosesnya?

signal_interpretation.positive: Peran penandatangan + estimasi durasi disebut konkret — akses otoritas bisa divalidasi
signal_interpretation.negative: Tidak tahu siapa penandatangannya — kontak saat ini kemungkinan bukan pemegang keputusan
